brief:
Women in Khan Younis are meeting in a concealed tent to confront the psychological and emotional burdens of conflict, according to Palestine News Network. The hidden gathering space, covered with white tarpaulin and accessed through a worn cloth entrance, provides a private refuge as the group convenes during evening hours to address war-related trauma in conditions of extreme heat and displacement.

The tent operates as an informal support mechanism for women navigating loss and displacement in Gaza. Women facing restricted mobility and safety concerns have created the private space to process collective suffering away from public view.
dek: Khan Younis / PNN / Fidaa Mohammad Abdel Jawad – After hours of scorching sun and as sunset approached, a group of women quietly slipped into a secret tent covered with a white tarpaulin, its entrance a worn piece of cloth. It was a small, private space where…
title: Khan Younis women gather in secret tent to share war's hidden toll
